observation_summary: A NullPointerException occurs when calling appendFixedWidthPadLeft or appendFixedWidthPadRight with a null object when the null text configuration is not set.
reasoning_summary: The code attempts to call the .length() method on a string variable 'str' without verifying if it is null. The variable 'str' is derived from 'getNullText()', which can return null if not explicitly configured. When 'getNullText()' returns null, the subsequent call to 'str.length()' triggers a NullPointerException. The fix introduces a null check to ensure that if 'str' is null, it defaults to an empty string, preventing the dereference error.
